candidate.name: Conditional pairing of two complete class streams under a fixed mask
candidate.human_writer_model: Choose a class-pattern template, independently choose an ordered string for each of its two disjoint classes, and weave the strings into the fixed template. This is an explicit independence submodel, not a claim that native classes are sounds.
candidate.unknown: Do the two ordered streams have preferred partners beyond their local marginal inventories and the complete class mask? GDT1265 varied masks with streams held fixed; it did not answer this dual pairing question.
candidate.distinct_prediction: Given the declared local stratum and full class mask, class-1 streams are exchangeable across class-0 carriers under the independent-choice model. A retained actual cross-stream score excess contradicts that independence contract.
candidate.smallest_test: Use unchanged GDT1233 eligible working-unit words, GDT1264 frozen labels and GDT1279 frozen odd-leaf exact-position transition table. On even leaves, exchange one COMPLETE class stream among words sharing source page, Currier and exact full class mask. Preserve every stream, within-stream order, mask, length, positional class margins and local stream frequencies. Score only strictly inner cross-class transitions using the frozen table. Before native scoring, freeze all weights, unclassified-unit exclusions, mobile-capacity requirements and a source-free proof/validator. No new training or smoothing.

research_outcomes.positive: Reject this independent two-stream construction and require a coupled stream-selection or word-level constraint; do not infer a language, lexical meaning, or causal interleaving.
research_outcomes.adequate_nonconfirmation: No lead against this fixed independence contrast; no independence proof and no automatic repartition or null retune.
research_outcomes.capacity_stop: Stop this fixed discriminator; no mask coarsening or pooling after outcome.

important_limits: The learned partition is a working representation, not the actual alphabet.
Full-mask conditioning is legitimate only for the explicitly independent-given-mask writer; other source languages can couple mask and payload.
Score must be recomputed from reconstructed complete words, not shuffled stored gains.
Within-page words can retain further physical-position or semantic dependencies; positive excess identifies coupling under the stated stratum only.
Novel-interior membership must not become a post-recombination outcome filter; primary should retain the fixed eligible ALL scope.
Readers remain alternate readings of one manuscript.
No native counts or capacity checks were performed by this review.

predecessor_distinctions.GDT1279: Exact previous-unit prediction does not preserve and cross-pair full stream marginals, so it does not itself quantify this independence contrast.
predecessor_distinctions.GDT1285: Failed fixed two-previous-unit estimator is not a stream-exchange test; do not repair that estimator.
predecessor_distinctions.GDT1246: Fixed dy-final literal half-diagonal test had immobile observed repetitions; this is not a new ending/half-split/repeat endpoint. It changes the mechanism to independent class streams and must pass its own capacity review.
predecessor_distinctions.GDT1344: Within-class sorting is contradicted; proposed streams preserve arbitrary order and do not assert sorting.
predecessor_distinctions.IDEA000883: Inter-hand spelling transport still lacks independent correspondence; this proposal does not infer correspondences or treat readers as hands.
